issues.title: Default sender name on emails
issues.problem_statement: The order confirmation email still shows the default sender name, and the customer wants to use their brand name.

evidence: I placed the test order. And yes, the confirmation email just arrived in my inbox!

items.description: Support explained that the default sender name can be changed under Email settings, Sender name.
